The '''C-13 prototype droid''' was a four-legged prototype [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] designed in the Research and Development sector of the [[Okara Droid Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. It was armed with two powerful [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] on its arms. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces invaded the factory and activated the R&D department's machinery to create the droid from the designs, and after it was destroyed its [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]] was recovered for study.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The C-13 Prototype Droid appears as the main boss of the Area mission "Research and Development" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which occurs in the Research and Development area of the Okara Droid Factory&mdash;a Heroic area in the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
